verdict.line: You lose if you let Teemo poke you down before level 6; you win if you survive to Wither plus Fury of the Sands and all-in off that combo.

brief.thesis: Teemo's whole kit is built to keep you outside your 255-range Siphoning Strike using 680-range Blinding Dart and passive Move Quick speed, and he has zero hard CC or dash to answer you once you close that gap. The 52.1% head-to-head over 140 games and Nasus's listed solo-kill edge both come from the same flip point: level 6, when Wither's deceleration and Fury of the Sands' extended range let you force a fight he can't kite out of.

theirWindow.when: Before level 6, his Q is up
theirWindow.what: He zones you with Blinding Dart (680 range, 8s cooldown) which blinds your autos and denies Soul Eater lifesteal, then kites with Move Quick's passive speed and ticks Toxic Shot damage on every poke auto. Don't walk up to trade here — farm with Siphoning Strike (255 range) only when he's out of position.

yourWindow.what: Land W (Wither, 700 range, 15→11s cooldown) to decelerate his movement and attack speed, then pop R (Fury of the Sands, 400 range, 120s cooldown) for the range and health-drain boost and finish with Q. Without a dash or hard CC, he cannot escape a Withered all-in.

start.why: Highest measured win rate at 57.5% over 87 games; the extra sustain and mana help you spam Siphoning Strike for stacks without being able to fight yet.

boots.why: 54.3% win rate over 94 games; the magic resist directly answers Toxic Shot's damage-over-time and softens Blinding Dart's upfront hit.

core.why: Core of the highest-winrate path (58.8% over 17 games); the damage spike is what makes post-6 Wither all-ins actually kill him.
Stacks with Soul Eater lifesteal and cuts healing-reduction risk while adding magic resist against his poison poke.
Completes the top core path; the attack speed slow helps you stay on top of him once Wither expires.

the game goes long and you need to be unkillable in teamfights while split pushing

runes.keystoneWhy: 48.6% win rate at 38.1% pick, the top measured page; the extra movement speed and sustain on hit let you dodge Blinding Dart windups and close distance safely pre-6.

summoners.why: Flash plus Teleport posts the highest measured win rate (67.4%); Flash covers the gap-close onto a kiting Teemo when Wither is down, and Teleport resets you to lane to keep stacking Q uncontested. Ghost plus Teleport (39.6% pick) is the safer, more common alternative if you want guaranteed stick power over a flash engage.

playing.title: Farm safe pre-6
playing.detail: Stay at max Siphoning Strike range and never walk up to trade before level 6; Blinding Dart's blind removes your Soul Eater lifesteal on contact.

playing.title: Shred waves with Spirit Fire
playing.detail: Drop E (650 range, 12s cooldown) on contested caster minions to clear fast and pre-apply the armor reduction so your post-6 autos hit harder.

playing.title: Wither before you commit
playing.detail: W must land before you approach — it's the only thing that stops his Move Quick kiting, since he has no dash or hard CC otherwise.

playing.title: All-in the instant R is up
playing.detail: From level 6, use Fury of the Sands' extended range and health drain together with a landed Wither to catch him before he reaches his 680-range poke distance again.

playing.title: Respect his invisibility timer
playing.detail: Camouflage goes active if he stands still and takes no actions; expect an attack-speed burst right after he decloaks, so don't walk into brush edges unchecked.

playing.title: Assume traps near river entrances
playing.detail: Noxious Trap has only a 1s cooldown per cast once he hits 6, so treat jungle entrances and river brush as mined before you blind-chase him off lane.

playing.title: Prioritize killing minions, not just hitting them
playing.detail: Every Siphoning Strike kill permanently empowers future casts; this scaling, not lane trades, is what wins the level 14+ split push.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build order, boots, runes, and summoner spells above are measured OP.GG data on the current patch (11,062-game Nasus top sample, 140 games specifically vs Teemo); the trade timings, cooldown reads, and lane plan are my own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not step within Teemo’s range to avoid being punished. Allow Teemo to gain lane control while focusing on farming with [Q], and try go in for the kill post-level 6 with Unsealed Spellbook + Fury of the Sands [R].
